race.comment: CASHOUT (5) looks the one to beat. He was a dominant winner here first up before looking the winner in the straight at Sandown Hillside last time, run down by Veyepee who flew home and has won dominantly again since. That looks great form and he's one suited by the track-switch. Huge chance. LET IT BEEL (8) presents third up having won well fresh before a strong closing second at Sale. He'll take holding out but synthetic is unknown. CASTELLITO (10) is racing well and maps for every hope, she was game in town last time when just finding one better. Right in this. HAPPY LINK (11) is racing consistently and does boast a win on synthetic here which is worth plenty. D Lane hops aboard and she should take some beating.
